verdict.rationale: Paddle has no general rule or workflow builder. Its event-driven automation comes in two narrow forms. Webhooks push real-time event notifications, but you must host your own handlers to act on them. Payment Recovery is configurable, letting you choose what happens to past-due subscriptions after failed payments. Beyond these, Paddle runs a few built-in automatic behaviors, such as creating transactions on subscription lifecycle events and creating a subscription when an invoice is issued. missing for 10: a user-definable rules/automation engine (custom event→condition→action rules), no-code or agent-configurable automations beyond dunning settings, independent hands-on corroboration.
